description.en: Blastronaut Zombie boosts to float over all but the tallest plant barriers.
description.zh: 喷气宇航员僵尸按下油门能飞跃植物，除非植物能高到挡住他。

chat.en: Blastronaut's rocket-pack is strictly ornamental; his hovering ability comes from a deep meditative state and from being full of helium.
chat.zh: 喷气宇航员僵尸的火箭背包只是装饰品，他的飘浮能力来自于深度冥想和充满氦气的状态。

text.en: floats over low plants, boosts over most other plants
text.zh: 飞跃低矮的植物，喷气越过大部分其他植物
